title: What an embedding actually represents
subtitle: Turn meaning-related content into vectors for retrieval
learning_objective: Explain embeddings as numerical representations and their role in similarity search.

source_refs.title: OpenAI: Embeddings guide

scenes.title: SEARCH BY MEANING
scenes.body: A user asks “How do I stop a service from crashing?” but the document says “prevent cascading failures.” Keyword search may miss the connection.

scenes.title: Represent content as vectors
scenes.body: An embedding model maps text into a list of numbers. Similarity measures can help retrieve items whose representations are close, but vectors do not guarantee perfect understanding.

scenes.title: Similarity is not truth
scenes.body: Retrieval quality depends on the model, chunking, distance metric, filters, and evaluation. A close vector match can still be irrelevant.

scenes.question: What is a common use for text embeddings?
options: Represent text for semantic similarity search
Guarantee every retrieved result is correct
scenes.explanation: Embeddings provide numerical representations that can be compared to retrieve semantically related content.

scenes.title: Remember this
scenes.body: Embeddings help find related content; retrieval still needs evaluation and appropriate ranking.
